observations: Outside containment, the existing flat profile environment reproduced 0x80070003 for both Windows Known Folder APIs.
With the same relocated environment, adding USERPROFILE/AppData/Local and Roaming restored successful flags=0 queries.
Reports contain only fixed case labels, numeric API results and booleans; no user paths or token identifiers.
limitations: This is an outside-container Win32 directory control, not a PSEC or GUI application acceptance result.
The Windows 11 control ran on an ARM host with build 26200.9457, not the user target 26200.9711.
